name: Boo Wants Friends
source:
It has been three weeks since Cassia's older sister, Senna, and her party have left on a quest. Having always dreamt of being a courageous adventurer, Cassia sets out to find her sister. Following the marks left by the party, the young girl stumbles upon a strange black house, where she is greeted by a small green plushie by the name of Boo.

[From [url=https://novaswarm-vt3.itch.io/boo-wants-friends]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
卡西娅的姐姐赛娜和她的同伴离开去执行任务已经三个星期了。卡西娅一直梦想成为一名勇敢的冒险家，她出发寻找她的妹妹。循着队伍留下的痕迹，年轻的女孩偶然发现了一座奇怪的黑房子，在那里迎接她的是一只名叫布的绿色小毛绒玩具。

[来自[url=https://novaswarm-vt3.itch.io/boo-wants-friends]itch.io[/url]]
